primary.question: does the same fitted continuation rule predict better when the junction angle comes from the export's authored endpoint tangents instead of chords?

selection.eligible: a rule abstains on nothing in the training rows and both classes are present there; abstentions are reported but never silently dropped from a decision
selection.ties: higher precision, then higher recall, then the rule name; every tied rule is reported
selection.not_estimable: a fold with no training row, or a fold whose training set lacks a class, selects nothing and its held-out rows are unscored; a fold with no positive or no negative held-out row reports a null precision or recall
selection.control_protocol: the stock controls are never training rows for any selection and are evaluated as held-out packages trained only on the cohort

labels.positive: complete and released native path whose returned first and last positions equal the requested literal offsets
labels.negative: complete and released selected request whose native result reports success=false; an observed failure for that exact request, mode, flags and protocol, never a geographic negative
labels.unknown: incomplete, unreleased, endpoint-mismatched or absent observed row; never scored
